notes.note: Fix round 4 of the delivery-state change: another window's queue-change notice only re-projects (it no longer starts a flush, and a held copy listed from another window no longer counts as a waiting row); public outbox rows carry sendUnderWay only while the claiming renderer's Web Lock is held, so the list reads Sending only then and the bubble agrees; Discard… stays mounted and the shared confirmation takes and returns focus; the composer's confirmation opens as its own popover; the phone sheet's inline actions are a group of buttons; the accepted outbox note reads in sentence case and outbox text wraps and clamps to two lines. chat.css changed only for the phone sheet's '.message-details__menu > button' selector (was [role=menuitem]) and the composer confirmation's popover padding. This document's menu claims (the dock chooser's menuitemradio group, the no-nested-menu rule) concern other surfaces. No prose change.
